lines.5: 「The work wrapped up in no time, so we may as well have some fun. Come in.」
lines.6: 「Even the decor has such a charming commoner feel.」
lines.8: 「I can sense someone inside. Hey, Leo, are you home?」
lines.14: 「Konoe, wait there. Don't show your face.」
lines.16: 「I didn't tell Otome-san you were coming over.」
lines.18: 「I'm not thrilled, but if you're that insistent...」
lines.26: 「Ow, ow! You'll yank it out! It'll come right off!」
lines.27: 「Trying to enter someone else's room the moment I turn my back? I won't allow it.」
lines.31: 「They said they wanted to come over, so I brought them.」
lines.33: 「Honestly... Mind your behavior from now on.」
lines.36: 「Why, Tsushima-kun. What are you doing here?」
lines.38: 「Is your date with Konoe already over?」
lines.42: 「There are women's shoes by the front door that aren't Kurogane-senpai's size.」
lines.44: 「I think Nao-chan might be in Tsushima-kun's room.」
lines.45: 「I see. Then we ought to take the hint and...」
lines.50: 「Don't tell me... it's so suspicious you can't show it to us?」
lines.55: 「Leo's dead set against it. Leave him alone.」
lines.56: All right, I held them off!
